name: putField appends a new field
put replaces by id in place and drops an output of the other kind with that id
removeOutput removes the output and ignores unknown ids
sections: put replaces and appends, setCopies sets
removeSection drops a section and setCopies null clears copy selection
steps: putStep replaces in place and appends, setPreamble sets
removeStep drops a step and an empty preamble removes it
missing blocks are created
removeOutput removes a table
a non-preamble change keeps the preamble
setCopies null without copies leaves no copies key
an empty preamble is dropped by an unrelated change
revise answers ride along and change nothing themselves
setDocumentMapping creates the mapping, pins the ontologies and adds prefixes
setDocumentMapping keeps hand prefixes and the outputs' mappings
putFieldMapping replaces a field's mapping, with alternatives kept out of the draft
putFieldMapping on a recipe with no mapping creates one with an empty document class
putTableMapping replaces a table's mapping
removeMapping drops a field's mapping, or one column of a table
removeMapping of a whole table, and of something unmapped, changes only what exists
putLocalTerm replaces a term with the same IRI and appends a new one
sections and steps: a repeating section with keyFrom and a keyColumn step
setDocumentMapping sets the value-node defaults
setDocumentMapping without valueNodes keeps the draft's
putTableMapping with a value-node column
putField and putTable keep the constraints an output had, where its type still takes them
